meta.caveat: record_count, ui_consumed, ci_tested, and automated_update_workflows are computed from the current repository state every run. Everything else (source_org, source_url, license, known_coverage_holes, known_quality_issues) is declared once in dataset_registry.json and requires a human to update when it changes. A dataset with has_data:false means this repository currently holds zero records for it, whatever the engine built to consume it can do.

datasets.name: Parcel service registry (production)
datasets.source_org: 58 individual county/city GIS departments
datasets.update_frequency_declared: live (fetched per map viewport from each jurisdiction's own service)
datasets.license: Public government open data; per-service terms vary and are not separately tracked here.
datasets.known_coverage_holes: Geometry coverage is 58 of ~3,000+ US counties. Most jurisdictions provide geometry + identity only; ownership/assessment/sales/zoning require the multi-source enrichment engine, which currently has zero production jurisdictions with a declared enrichment block.
datasets.known_quality_issues: Field depth varies enormously by jurisdiction; see data/parcel_coverage_metrics.json for the per-category breakdown this file does not duplicate.

datasets.name: Parcel source catalog (candidates + production + rejected)
datasets.source_org: Various state/county GIS portals, ArcGIS Hub, ArcGIS Online
datasets.license: Aggregates public open-data listings; not itself a data source.
datasets.known_coverage_holes: Candidate entries are catalogued but unverified until promoted to the registry; most entries are still 'candidate' status.
datasets.known_quality_issues: A catalogued service's geographic coverage is not independently confirmed until a human promotes it — sample-matching a few parcels inside a county is not proof of full-county coverage (see BUG_TRACKER.md's Shorewood/Will County case).

datasets.name: Facility index (production, map-consumed)
datasets.source_org: Multiple (see facility_sources.json)
datasets.license: Aggregates public sources; OSM contributions under ODbL where applicable.
datasets.known_coverage_holes: Below the ~6,000-facility target discussed for a comprehensive national census. No explicit campus→building parent/child hierarchy yet — campus_total_mw and campus_size_acres exist as flat per-record fields, so a multi-building campus is not guaranteed to be modeled as one entity with children.
datasets.known_quality_issues: Locations are approximate (city-level accuracy per the dataset's own disclaimer); capacity figures are publicly reported estimates that may be stale.

datasets.name: Facility pipeline source registry
datasets.source_org: OSM Overpass, DataCenterMap, Equinix, Digital Realty, FERC, SEC EDGAR, hyperscaler press feeds
datasets.license: Public web sources; scraping ToS not independently reviewed per source.
datasets.known_coverage_holes: Only 8 sources configured; no state PUC filings, no CBRE/JLL/Datacenter Dynamics market reports (paid or ToS-restricted).
datasets.known_quality_issues: Confidence tiers are self-declared per source, not independently audited.

datasets.name: Electric transmission lines
datasets.source_org: HIFLD (Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data)
datasets.known_coverage_holes: None documented beyond normal HIFLD reporting lag.
datasets.known_quality_issues: None currently documented; this HIFLD endpoint has stayed live (see fetch_infrastructure.py header comment for the substations/power-plants endpoints that did not).

datasets.name: Electric power substations
datasets.source_org: HIFLD (via a third-party ArcGIS mirror after the original HIFLD org's service was retired)
datasets.license: Public open data mirror; original publisher's terms presumed to carry over but not independently re-confirmed for the mirror.
datasets.known_coverage_holes: CONFIRMED SEVERE: this mirror returns only ~25 US substations after the >=69kV filter, nationwide. The real HIFLD substations dataset has tens of thousands of records. This is real, correctly-fetched data — not fabricated — but is NOT equivalent coverage to a full national substation layer. Documented in fetch_infrastructure.py and BUG_TRACKER.md; a full-coverage replacement has not been found.
datasets.known_quality_issues: Schema differs from the original HIFLD org (MAX_VOLT/MIN_VOLT instead of one VOLTAGE field, COUNTYFIPS instead of COUNTY_FIPS) — handled in the adapter, but any future source swap must re-verify field names rather than assume the original schema.

datasets.name: Power generation facilities
datasets.source_org: EPA Facility Registry Service (EIA-860 generator data joined with FRS)
datasets.known_coverage_holes: This source has NO nameplate-capacity field of any kind -- plant identity, location, operating status, and primary fuel source are real and populated; capacity_mw is always None, never fabricated. A capacity-bearing free source (e.g. a verified EIA-860 bulk download) has not yet been found/verified.
datasets.known_quality_issues: Source is one row per GENERATOR, deduplicated to one record per PLANT_CODE by this pipeline -- a plant with many small generators and a plant with one large generator are indistinguishable without capacity data.

datasets.name: Utility service territories
datasets.source_org: Hand-curated (illustrative, not sourced from a utility territory GIS layer)
datasets.geographic_scope_declared: 6 illustrative utility footprints, not a national layer
datasets.known_coverage_holes: NOT A REAL DATASET YET. 6 hand-typed FIPS-list entries (e.g. "Dominion Energy (Virginia)") stand in for what should be a real utility service-territory polygon layer. HIFLD publishes an Electric Retail Service Territories layer that has not yet been evaluated/ingested.
datasets.known_quality_issues: Presented on the map without a distinct 'illustrative' visual treatment from verified layers — flagged as a UI honesty gap, see docs/DATA_COVERAGE.md.

datasets.name: ISO/RTO regions
datasets.known_coverage_holes: NOT IMPLEMENTED. No ISO/RTO region layer exists anywhere in the repository. FERC and most ISOs (PJM, MISO, ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, ISO-NE, NYISO) publish free boundary maps/data; none are currently ingested.

datasets.name: Generator interconnection queue positions
datasets.source_org: FERC (registered as a facility-pipeline source, not yet feeding a dedicated dataset)
datasets.update_frequency_declared: n/a — registered as a facility source only
datasets.known_coverage_holes: The 'ferc_queue' facility source in facility_sources.json feeds the DATA CENTER pipeline (detecting large-load interconnection requests), not a standalone interconnection-queue dataset. LBNL's free public interconnection queue database (queues.lbl.gov) is a plausible richer source that has not been evaluated.

datasets.name: Fiber routes (none — removed)
datasets.source_org: Hand-authored, not sourced from any carrier or public fiber-route dataset
datasets.geographic_scope_declared: None. The 3 fabricated entries this dataset used to hold were removed.
datasets.known_coverage_holes: REMEDIATED. This dataset used to hold 3 hardcoded named routes ("Zayo Northern Virginia Dark Fiber Ring", "Lumen/CenturyLink Iowa Backbone", "Zayo Pacific NW Fiber Route") with hand-typed coordinate paths attributed to real carriers with no evidence. They were removed rather than kept as "illustrative" -- attributing an invented path to a named company by name is a fabrication risk a map tooltip disclaimer does not resolve. No free, reliable, nationwide fiber-route dataset is known to exist (see js/parcel/proximity-layers.js's fiber registerUnavailable(), which this file now matches). data/validate_sources.py and tests/test_fiber_network_honesty.py now require any future entry to carry a real, checked source URL before it may name a carrier.

datasets.name: FCC broadband fiber availability by county
datasets.source_org: FCC National Broadband Map / Broadband Data Collection (BDC)
datasets.geographic_scope_declared: United States, county-level, if the fetcher succeeds
datasets.known_coverage_holes: NOT CURRENTLY WORKING. fetch_infrastructure.py's fetch_fiber_coverage() targets an FCC county endpoint that now requires a registered API token this adapter does not send (HTTP 405/token error, documented in the script). Even if fixed, this measures MARKETED RESIDENTIAL BROADBAND AVAILABILITY, not physical long-haul/metro fiber routes or dark-fiber availability — the two must never be conflated, and this dataset should never be labeled as 'fiber infrastructure' if revived.

datasets.name: County-level water stress index
datasets.source_org: Derived proxy (exact upstream methodology not separately documented in-repo)
datasets.license: Unclear — not tracked at the per-county level.
datasets.known_coverage_holes: Only 79 of ~3,000 US counties have a water stress value. This is an index/score (0–4 scale), not a water utility service territory, treatment plant, or main dataset — none of those exist in the repository yet.
datasets.known_quality_issues: A single scalar stress index cannot answer utility capacity questions; the parcel suitability/proximity engines correctly treat proximity as distinct from capacity, but no water infrastructure PROXIMITY layer (mains, treatment plants, service areas) exists to feed that distinction yet.

datasets.name: Wastewater treatment infrastructure
datasets.known_coverage_holes: NOT IMPLEMENTED. EPA's Clean Watersheds Needs Survey and the EPA Facility Registry Service both publish free wastewater facility data that has not yet been evaluated.

datasets.name: Interstate/major road network for proximity analysis
datasets.source_org: BTS National Highway Planning Network (target, not yet ingested)
datasets.license: Public federal open data (BTS), if ingested.
datasets.known_coverage_holes: NOT IMPLEMENTED as a dataset the proximity engine can query. js/parcel/proximity-layers.js declares 'interstates' as PENDING_VERIFICATION with no endpoint attached — the base map's road tiles (OSM basemap) are visual only and are not queryable for distance calculations.

datasets.name: Rail network
datasets.known_coverage_holes: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Deprioritized — rail is a lower-value signal for data center siting than power/fiber/water/road access; noted for completeness per the requested category list.

datasets.name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
datasets.source_org: FEMA
datasets.update_frequency_declared: live (queried per-parcel bounding box at analysis time, no local cache)
datasets.known_coverage_holes: ENGINE EXISTS, LIVE, WIRED (verified 2026-08-08 via a real GitHub Actions dispatch against hazards.fema.gov -- confirmed layer 28, real fields FLD_ZONE/ZONE_SUBTY/SFHA_TF/STATIC_BFE). No local record count applies -- this is a live per-parcel query, not stored data, so has_data is reported false even though the wiring is real (see data_catalog ALLOWED_WITH_NO_DATA). FEMA does not map 100% of US counties; an area with no mapped floodplain returns zero intersecting features honestly, indistinguishable at the API level from an area FEMA has simply never studied.
datasets.known_quality_issues: FEMA flood panels are regulatory products of varying age -- many effective panels are a decade or more old. See the caveat text in constraint-layers.js.

datasets.name: USFWS National Wetlands Inventory
datasets.source_org: US Fish & Wildlife Service
datasets.known_coverage_holes: ENGINE EXISTS, NO DATA. Same status as fema_flood: registered unavailable pending endpoint verification in js/parcel/constraint-layers.js.

datasets.name: USGS Protected Areas Database of the United States
datasets.source_org: USGS
datasets.known_coverage_holes: ENGINE EXISTS, NO DATA. Same status as fema_flood.

datasets.name: Zoning district standards (pilot)
datasets.source_org: Individual county zoning ordinances (manually researched)
datasets.license: Public government ordinance text, hand-transcribed into structured data.
datasets.known_coverage_holes: 1 of 58 production parcel jurisdictions has structured zoning district/setback/permitted-use data. This is the input the conceptual buildable envelope and suitability land-use scoring depend on for anything beyond the raw zoning_code string.
datasets.known_quality_issues: Hand-transcription from ordinance text carries transcription-error risk; docs/ZONING_VERIFICATION.md documents the verification process for this one jurisdiction.

datasets.name: Parcel assessment/sales/ownership (via multi-source enrichment)
datasets.source_org: County CAMA/assessor services (per jurisdiction, joined by the enrichment engine)
datasets.geographic_scope_declared: 0 of 58 production jurisdictions currently declare a live enrichment source
datasets.update_frequency_declared: live, per parcel fetch, where configured
datasets.license: Public government open data; per-service terms vary.
datasets.known_coverage_holes: ENGINE EXISTS, ZERO PRODUCTION DATA. js/parcel/enrichment.js and enrichment-arcgis-table.js are built and tested (89 + 47 assertions), and data/parcel_pipeline/discover_enrichment.mjs can find and empirically verify CAMA join candidates — but no registry.js entry has an enrichment block yet, because this session's sandbox could not reach county GIS hosts to run the discovery workflow. The pilot PR (Loudoun/Prince William/Fairfax VA) is unblocked but unexecuted.

datasets.name: Census County Business Patterns + County demographic/economic indicators
datasets.source_org: US Census Bureau

datasets.name: FRED macroeconomic series
datasets.source_org: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
datasets.license: Public, free API (registration required but not billed).

datasets.name: County-level data-center political risk score
datasets.source_org: Derived from restrictions_raw.json + state_regulations tracking (in-house scoring model)
datasets.known_coverage_holes: 112 of ~3,000 counties. This is the index the parcel suitability score's 'policy' component reads.
datasets.known_quality_issues: A forward-looking risk indicator, not a record of current law — already labeled as such everywhere it is consumed (see js/parcel/suitability.js's policy component rule text).

datasets.name: Tracked data-center policy restrictions/moratoria
datasets.source_org: State/local legislation and ordinance tracking (government_sources.json registry)

datasets.name: AI/data-center industry news feed
datasets.source_org: Multiple public news/press RSS sources (see news_sources.json)
datasets.license: Aggregates public RSS feeds; full-article rights remain with original publishers, only headlines/summaries are stored.
